caption: The video captures a close side view of a steam locomotive's driving-wheel gear, red spoked wheels with bright steel rims joined by horizontal coupling rods beneath a black boiler. A thin red valve rod runs along the running-board line while a heavy steam cloud billows around the wheelset, a steel gantry at upper left at the start. The wheels turn continuously, the crank pins sweeping their circular cycle so the long rod to the crosshead tilts and re-levels repeatedly, marking steady motion. The framing tightens on the lower mechanism, the gantry sliding out of view and the boiler edge lifting toward the top of frame. A dense steam mass builds on the right, progressively hiding the front wheel, cylinder and valve gear. The rear wheels stay visible through the haze, still rotating as the locomotive shifts leftward within the crop.
